regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, introduction, and article metadata
regions.finding: Article identity and the current gold-catalyzed benzannulation claim were reviewed. Prior Pt/Au carbazole work is cited context; the paper's online supplementary-data statement does not establish an associated SI file in this workspace.

The upper PtCl2 carbazole arrow is cited prior work and the lower X=S/O arrow is a generic proposed extension with R groups. They are classified together as a general reaction overview, not current preparative experiments.

regions.region: page 1 bottom Results and discussion continuing to page 2 Scheme 2
regions.finding: Two current preliminary results begin here and are completed visually on page 2: PtCl2/toluene gives 92% recovery of 1a, while AuCl/DCE gives cycloisomerization product 4 in 71%. They are retained as separate optimization records.

unresolved: Scheme 2 preliminary runs omit scale, temperature, time, workup, purification, and isolated masses.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Scheme 2 and continuation prose
regions.finding: Three numbered current experiments were resolved: PtCl2/toluene with 92% recovery; AuCl/DCE with 71% product 4; and AuCl(PPh3)/AgBF4/DCE with 5% NMR 3a plus 29% NMR product 4. No conditions were merged across these rows.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 rows 1-10 and footnotes a-d
regions.finding: Ten independent optimization experiments were retained with 2a 0.2 mmol, AuCl(PPh3)/silver-salt catalyst 0.01 mmol (5 mol%), solvent 2 mL, room temperature, 12 h, crude-1H-NMR yields, internal standard, and entry-9/10 recovery footnotes. Table dashes remain source markers.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 rows 1-8 and footnotes a-c
regions.finding: Eight independent scope rows were mapped to their detailed section-4.4 preparations on pages 5-6, preserving row time/yield and the distinct 4 mmol scale-up in entry 6. Matching table and detailed appearances are merged rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 2 center-right Table 3 rows 1-7 and two-arrow header
regions.finding: Each row's acetylation and gold cyclization arrows were retained as successive stage records. Stage-specific acetate yields remain missing; the printed yields are explicitly combined isolated yields from starting allenol 1 to final product 3.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 3 and mechanistic-isotope prose

regions.region: page 3 center-left Scheme 5 and mechanistic prose
regions.finding: M1-M3, the gold-carbene/1,2-H-shift branch, and the aromatic-gold/protonolysis branch are explicitly proposed and classified as one mechanism record, not observed intermediate experiments.

Four separate acetylations to 2c, 2d, 2f, and 2g were retained with exact reactant/reagent quantities, times, isolated masses/yields, and row-specific chromatographic eluents.
